suspended.title: Workspace suspended
suspended.sentence: This workspace is suspended because its subscription ended or a payment failed.
suspended.adminUntil: As an admin you can export the data and pay in Billing until {{date}}.

sender.title: Email sender
sender.help: Invitations, digests and survey emails go out from your own domain once it is verified. Sign-in emails always come from the service's own address.
sender.fallback: Until a domain is verified, these emails are sent as "{{org}} via Liaison".
sender.recordsHelp: Add these DNS records at your DNS host, then press Verify. DNS changes can take a few minutes to an hour.
sender.verifiedHelp: Verified: your organization's emails now go out from this domain.
sender.domainLimit: This domain cannot be added right now; we have been told.
sender.domainInvalid: This is not a domain that can send email.
sender.domainTaken: This domain is already used by another organization.
sender.unavailable: The email sender settings are unavailable right now. Try again shortly.

billing.pastDue: Payment failed: pay the open invoice to keep using AI features.
billing.ended: Your subscription has ended, so AI features are off. You can still export your data.
billing.paymentRequired: AI features are paused until the open invoice is paid. An admin can pay it in Billing.
billing.outOfCredits: You are out of credits, so the assistant has stopped until more are added. Everything else keeps working. An admin can buy credits in Billing.

caps.seatLimitReached: This organization uses all the seats its plan includes. Move to a plan with more in Billing, or an admin can deactivate someone first.
caps.customAppLimitReached: This organization uses all the custom apps its plan includes. Remove one first, or move to a plan with more.
caps.auditDaysLimitReached: The plan keeps the audit log for fewer days. Choose a shorter retention.
caps.storageLimitReached: This organization uses all the storage its plan includes. Move to a plan with more in Billing, or free some space first.

seats.preview: Preview is limited to {{limit}} people: it is only meant for a quick look at Liaison.
seats.base: Base is limited to {{limit}} people: it is meant for a small company running its day-to-day on Liaison.
seats.pro: Pro is limited to {{limit}} people: it is meant for larger teams with heavier use.
seats.next: {{plan}} allows {{limit}}. Move to it in Billing, or an admin can deactivate someone first.
seats.nextUnlimited: {{plan}} has no limit on people. Move to it in Billing, or an admin can deactivate someone first.
seats.largest: This is the largest plan, so an admin needs to deactivate someone first.

storageGb.preview: Preview is limited to {{limit}} GB of storage: it is only meant for a quick look at Liaison, not for years of files.
storageGb.base: Base is limited to {{limit}} GB of storage: it is meant for a small company's everyday files and mail attachments.
storageGb.pro: Pro is limited to {{limit}} GB of storage: it is meant for larger teams with a long history of files.
storageGb.next: {{plan}} gives {{limit}} GB. Move to it in Billing, or free some space first.
storageGb.nextUnlimited: {{plan}} has no limit on storage. Move to it in Billing, or free some space first.
storageGb.largest: This is the largest plan, so some space needs to be freed first.

customApps.preview: Preview's custom app limit is {{limit}}: it is only meant for trying one out.
customApps.base: Base's custom app limit is {{limit}}: it is meant for the few tools a small company adds to its day-to-day.
customApps.pro: Pro's custom app limit is {{limit}}: it is meant for teams that build a lot on Liaison.
customApps.next: {{plan}} allows {{limit}}. Move to it in Billing, or remove one first.
customApps.nextUnlimited: {{plan}} has no limit on custom apps. Move to it in Billing, or remove one first.
customApps.largest: This is the largest plan, so one needs to be removed first.

auditDays.preview: Preview keeps the audit log for up to {{limit}} days: it is only meant for a quick look at Liaison.
auditDays.base: Base keeps the audit log for up to {{limit}} days: it is meant for a small company's everyday checks.
auditDays.pro: Pro keeps the audit log for up to {{limit}} days: it is meant for teams with longer review or compliance needs.
auditDays.next: {{plan}} keeps it for {{limit}} days. Choose a shorter retention, or move to it in Billing.
auditDays.nextUnlimited: {{plan}} has no limit on it. Choose a shorter retention, or move to it in Billing.
auditDays.largest: This is the largest plan, so choose a shorter retention.
